items.description: Awesome-Android-Reverse-Engineering is an amazing list for people who work in taking apart Android applications, systems, or components. Simply press to search for a keyword, go through our Contents Menu, or lookout for a '☆' indicating some great and up-to-date resources.

children.title: MobSF
children.description: Supports both static and dynamic analysis for Android app security testing.

repo_info.description: Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) is an automated, all-in-one mobile application (Android/iOS/Windows) pen-testing, malware analysis and security assessment framework capable of performing static and dynamic analysis.

children.title: QARK
children.description: An open-source tool for automatic Android app vulnerability scanning.

repo_info.description: Tool to look for several security related Android application vulnerabilities

children.title: Quark Engine
children.description: Integrates various tools as Quark Script APIs for mobile security research.

children.title: AndroBugs Framework
children.description: Analyzes and scans Android apps for security issues.

repo_info.description: AndroBugs Framework is an efficient Android vulnerability scanner that helps developers or hackers find potential security vulnerabilities in Android applications. No need to install on Windows.

children.title: Dexcalibur
children.description: Automated tool for analyzing and instrumenting Android applications.

repo_info.description: Reversense (Dexcalibur2) is a fully rewriting and rethinking of Dexcalibur.  Reversense is a binary intelligence platform that automates the reverse engineering of mobile and embedded applications.

children.title: ☆ APK Dependency Graph
children.description: Visualizes APK class dependencies.

repo_info.description: Android class dependency visualizer. This tool helps to visualize the current state of the project.

children.title: DIS{integrity}
children.description: Analyzes APKs for root, integrity, and tamper detection.

repo_info.description: A tool for analysing Android APKs and extracting root, integrity, and tamper detection checks.

children.title: COVA
children.description: Computes path constraints based on user-defined APIs.

repo_info.description: COVA - A static analysis tool to compute path conditions

children.title: simplify
children.description: Android virtual machine and deobfuscator.

repo_info.description: Android virtual machine and deobfuscator

children.title: deoptfuscator
children.description: Tool for deobfuscating apps using control-flow obfuscation.

repo_info.description: Deobfuscator for Android Application

children.title: ☆ Obfu[DE]scate
children.description: De-obfuscation tool that uses fuzzy comparison logic.

repo_info.description: Obfu[DE]scate is a de-obfuscation tool for Android APKs that uses fuzzy comparison logic to identify similarities between functions, even if they have been renamed as part of obfuscation. It compares two versions of an APK and generates a mapping text file and an interactive HTML file as outputs!

children.title: TinySmaliEmulator
children.description: Minimalist smali emulator for "decrypting" obfuscated strings.

repo_info.description: A very minimalist smali emulator that could be used to "decrypt" obfuscated strings

children.title: Drozer
children.description: Framework for Android security testing with dynamic analysis features.

repo_info.description: The Leading Security Assessment Framework for Android.

children.title: AutoDroid
children.description: Mass APK gathering and analysis tool.

repo_info.description: A tool for automating interactions with Android devices - including ADB, AndroGuard, and Frida interactivity.

children.title: apk-mitm
children.description: Prepares APKs for HTTPS inspection.

repo_info.description: 🤖 A CLI application that automatically prepares Android APK files for HTTPS inspection

children.title: SSLsplit
children.description: Intercepts and manipulates SSL/TLS encrypted traffic.

repo_info.description: Transparent SSL/TLS interception

children.title: ☆ Objection
children.description: Runtime exploration tool to bypass app security controls.

repo_info.description: 📱 objection - runtime mobile exploration

children.title: RMS Runtime Mobile Security
children.description: Frida web interface.

repo_info.description: Runtime Mobile Security (RMS) 📱🔥  - is a powerful web interface that helps you to manipulate Android and iOS Apps at Runtime

children.title: jnitrace
children.description: Frida-based JNI API tracer.

repo_info.description: A Frida based tool that traces usage of the JNI API in Android apps.

children.title: ☆ FriDump
children.description: Uses Frida to dump memory of running apps.

repo_info.description: A universal memory dumper using Frida

children.title: ☆ Binder Trace
children.description: Intercepts and parses Android Binder messages.

repo_info.description: Binder Trace is a tool for intercepting and parsing Android Binder messages. Think of it as "Wireshark for Binder".

children.title: ☆ JADX
children.description: Decompiles APKs into Java source code.

repo_info.description: Dex to Java decompiler

children.title: FernFlower
children.description: Analytical decompiler for Java.

repo_info.description: IntelliJ IDEA & IntelliJ Platform

children.title: DEX2JAR
children.description: Converts DEX files to JAR files.

repo_info.description: Tools to work with android .dex and java .class files

children.title: Cfr
children.description: Supports decompilation of Android APK files.

repo_info.description: This is the public repository for the CFR Java decompiler

children.title: Procyon
children.description: Suite of Java decompilation tools.

repo_info.description: Procyon is a suite of Java metaprogramming tools, including a rich reflection API, a LINQ-inspired expression tree API for runtime code generation, and a Java decompiler.

children.title: Androguard
children.description: Analyzes and reverse engineers Android apps.

repo_info.description: Reverse engineering and pentesting for Android applications

children.title: APK Studio
children.description: Qt-based IDE for reverse-engineering APKs.

repo_info.description: Open-source, cross platform Qt6 based IDE for reverse-engineering Android application packages. It features a friendly IDE-like layout including code editor with syntax highlighting support for *.smali code files.

children.title: show-java
children.description: APK, JAR & Dex decompiler.

repo_info.description: An APK (android application), JAR & Dex decompiler for android.

children.title: apk2gold
children.description: Decompiles Android apps to Java (note: may be outdated).

repo_info.description: CLI tool for decompiling Android apps to Java. It does resources! It does Java! Its real easy!

children.title: AndroidProjectCreator
children.description: Converts APKs to Android Studio projects.

repo_info.description: Convert an APK to an Android Studio Project using multiple open-source decompilers

children.title: androwarn
children.description: Static code analyzer for malicious Android applications.

repo_info.description: Yet another static code analyzer for malicious Android applications

children.title: DroidDetective
children.description: Machine learning malware analysis for Android apps.

repo_info.description: A machine learning malware analysis framework for Android apps.

children.title: Cuckoo Droid
children.description: Automated Android malware analysis with Cuckoo Sandbox.

repo_info.description: CuckooDroid - Automated Android Malware Analysis with Cuckoo Sandbox.

children.title: Android Reverse Engineering Challenges
children.description: Curated list of reverse engineering challenges and CTFs.

repo_info.description: A curated list of CTF frameworks, libraries, resources and softwares

children.title: ☆ UnCrackable Mobile Apps
children.description: OWASP Android app CrackMes.

repo_info.description: The OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (MASTG) is a comprehensive manual for mobile app security testing and reverse engineering. It describes technical processes for verifying the OWASP Mobile Security Weakness Enumeration (MASWE) weaknesses, which are in alignment with the OWASP MASVS.

children.title: KGB Messenger
children.description: CTF challenge for learning Android reverse engineering.

repo_info.description: An Android CTF practice challenge

children.title: CyberTruckChallenge19
children.description: Security workshop material from CyberTruck Challenge 2019.

repo_info.description: Android security workshop material taught during the CyberTruck Challenge 2019 (Detroit USA).

children.title: uber-apk-signer
children.description: CLI tool for signing and zip aligning APKs.

repo_info.description: A cli tool that helps signing and zip aligning single or multiple Android application packages (APKs) with either debug or provided release certificates. It supports v1, v2 and v3 Android signing scheme has an embedded debug keystore and auto verifies after signing.

children.title: LADB
children.description: Local ADB shell for Android.

repo_info.description: A local ADB shell for Android!

children.title: Broken Droid Factory
children.description: Generates pseudo-random vulnerable Android apps for training.

repo_info.description: BDF is a Python tool designed to spin-up pseudo random vulnerable Android applications for training when it comes to vulnerability research, ethical hacking, and pen testing on Android apps.

children.title: RUNIC tamper detection demo
children.description: Demo for understanding Android tamper detection and integrity systems.

repo_info.description: 📱 RUNIC tamper detection demo - designed to serve as a parallel for understanding more complex tamper detection and integrity systems such as Google Play SafetyNet and Huawei Safety Detect.

children.title: Binwalk
children.description: Analyze, extract, and reverse engineer firmware images.

repo_info.description: Firmware Analysis Tool

children.title: FirmWire
children.description: Dynamic analysis platform for baseband firmware.

repo_info.description: FirmWire is a full-system baseband firmware emulation platform for fuzzing, debugging, and root-cause analysis of smartphone baseband firmwares

children.title: AFLSmart
children.description: Fuzzer optimized for firmware image analysis.

repo_info.description: Smart Greybox Fuzzing (https://thuanpv.github.io/publications/TSE19_aflsmart.pdf)
